summary.text: SCs and PRs get subsidies. LTVP holders can seek financial assistance if they need it.

details.heading: For SCs and PRs
details.body: Long-Term Care services may be free or kept affordable through Government subsidies.

details.heading: For LTVP holders
details.body: LTVP holders are not eligible for subsidies. If you need help, contact your service provider or AIC about financial assistance.

details.heading: Contact AIC
details.body: For more information on accessing LTC services, contact AIC at enquiries@aic.sg or 1800-650-6060.

sources.page_title: How are Long-Term Care (LTC) services made affordable for Singapore Citizens (SCs), Permanent Residents (PRs) and Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) Holders?

quotes.text: LTC services (such as those offered at Active Ageing Centres and Senior Care Centres) are either provided free or kept affordable through Government subsidies for Singapore Citizens (SCs) and Permanent Residents (PRs).
While LTVP holders are not eligible for subsidies, those in need may reach out to their service provider or the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) for financial assistance.
For more information on accessing LTC services, you may reach out to AIC at enquiries@aic.sg or 1800-650-6060.
